title.narrative: CDC Long term Development Impact study

description.narrative: The Longitudinal Mobilisation Study is the first in a series of sectoral evaluations being undertaken across British International Investment's (BII) portfolio to assess BII’s overall performance and effectiveness. The purpose of the Study is to examine BII’s impact on wider private sector investment activity and to provide evidence on whether and how the investment activity of BII is mobilising private sector investment in different contexts.
